changes.summary: Retained power after ignition off extended from 45 s to 60 s; the front-door-open cut-off is unchanged.
Trigger changed from the rain sensor to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. The vague 'quickly' became express-mode close with anti-pinch active.
Pinch detection force threshold lowered from 100 N to 80 N.
Minimum reversal distance increased from 125 mm to 150 mm. The 10 ms stop time and the 'or fully open, whichever is less' clause are unchanged.
Rewording only ('set itself to' became 'set its state to'). The 500 ms interruption and the not-normalized result are unchanged.
The vague 'limit' and 'safe value' are now quantified: the temperature threshold is 130 °C and the motor current limit is 15 A.
WLC_Status period shortened from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. The content is unchanged.
Narrowed to storing DTC B1A02 at more than 25 A for more than 50 ms. Stopping the motor and setting the fault state moved to the new WLC-037 and WLC-038.

tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-032. The test stays because WLC-004 still traces to it, and the 100 µA sleep-current check is still worth running (see concerns).

tests.new_procedure: Switch ignition off. Press the switch at 55 s and at 65 s, and also at 59 s and 61 s to bracket the limit. Repeat with a front door opened at 10 s, then press the switch. Also remove the trace to deleted WLC-023.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Window movement after ignition off, with no door opened
Window movement after a front door is opened

tests.reason: WLC-007 changed from 45 s to 60 s, so the 40 s and 50 s test points no longer bracket the limit. WLC-023 is deleted and its trace must go.

tests.new_procedure: With the window half open and the controller normalized, send the CAN request WLC_CloseAll from the body controller (the old rain signal is no longer the trigger). Repeat with an obstacle in the pinch zone to check that anti-pinch is active during the close.
tests.reason: The trigger and the required behaviour both changed, so the rain stimulus no longer verifies WLC-012. The test needs a different stimulus and new checks.

tests.new_procedure: At 13.5 V and 23 °C, express close onto the 10 N/mm pinch rod placed at 100 mm. Confirm that the window can travel the full 150 mm reversal from the pinch position, or is fully open before that.

new_pass_criteria.limit: At least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.reason: Both the detection threshold (80 N) and the reversal distance (150 mm) changed.

new_pass_criteria.limit: At least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.reason: The criteria inherit from TC-AP-01, so the 80 N threshold and the 150 mm reversal now apply at low voltage.

new_pass_criteria.limit: At least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.reason: The criteria inherit from TC-AP-01, so the 80 N threshold and the 150 mm reversal now apply at high voltage.

tests.new_procedure: As TC-AP-01 (updated) at 9.0 V and -30 °C. This is the cold and low-voltage corner that LL-2022-02 names as the worst case for stop time. Run it on every software release.

new_pass_criteria.limit: At least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.reason: The criteria inherit from TC-AP-01, so the new threshold and reversal apply in the worst-case corner for stop time.

new_pass_criteria.limit: At least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.reason: The criteria inherit from TC-AP-01, so the new threshold and reversal apply when hot.

tests.new_procedure: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-018. Keep the test and re-trace it to WLC-014. Rerun it with the 80 N threshold (see concerns).
tests.reason: WLC-018 is deleted, but the test checks for false pinch detection under vibration. It becomes more important with the lower threshold, so it is kept and re-traced rather than retired.
The WLC-021 change is editorial. The 500 ms interruption and the not-normalized result are unchanged, and the 400 ms and 600 ms test points still bracket the limit.

tests.new_procedure: Run open-close cycles until the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C. Check that the estimate is current before the limit check (LL-2024-01), and confirm the WLC-200 thermal module fix is present. Measure motor current while the limit is active.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Estimated motor temperature at which limiting starts

tests.reason: WLC-025 now gives numeric values (130 °C and 15 A), so 'motor current reduced' no longer verifies it.

tests.new_procedure: Record WLC_Status for 10 s while moving the window. Run once on a quiet bus and again under worst-case bus load, including a diagnostic session (LL-2024-09).

new_pass_criteria.limit: Window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state

tests.reason: The cycle time changed from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms.

tests.new_procedure: Block the window and inject 27 A for 100 ms. Add negative cases: 23 A for 100 ms, and 27 A for 40 ms. The motor-stop and fault-state checks move to the extension for WLC-037 and WLC-038 (see added requirements).

new_pass_criteria.limit: Stored when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms

tests.reason: WLC-030 now only requires storing B1A02. Stopping the motor and setting the fault state moved to WLC-037 and WLC-038.
Its only trace, WLC-033 'user friendly', is deleted, so it verifies no requirement in the new version.

added.extend_test: TC-DG-02 (extend and add the trace to WLC-037)
added.pass_criteria: With B1A02 stored after the 27 A for 100 ms injection, the motor is stopped. Run the same stimulus as TC-DG-02 and check motor current and movement. Also confirm the motor is not stopped by this requirement in the 23 A and 40 ms cases, where B1A02 is not stored.

added.extend_test: TC-DG-02 (extend and add the trace to WLC-038)
added.pass_criteria: With B1A02 stored, the fault state signal in WLC_Status is set. Check this in the recorded WLC_Status frames. Also confirm it is not set in the cases where B1A02 is not stored.

added.extend_test: New test needed: TC-AP-10, 'Express close inhibit after pinch reversal'. TC-AP-08 (repeated pinch lockout, WLC-019) is a possible host, but its content is not given, so confirm before extending it.
added.pass_criteria: After a pinch reversal, an express close request at about 1 s is not executed. Express close is accepted again after 2 s (test at 1.9 s and 2.1 s). Measure the time from the reversal, and state in the test whether it starts at detection or at the end of the reversal. Also check that manual close is still available during the 2 s.

concerns.concern: The threshold dropped from 100 N to 80 N, so false reversals are more likely. LL-2021-07 requires a new check of both false reversals and stop time after any threshold change. Rerun TC-AP-09 on the rough-road profile and add vibration to the TC-AP-01 to TC-AP-05 runs.

It traces to WLC-016 (pinch protection in manual and express mode), not to a changed requirement, but it uses the pinch threshold and reversal. Rerun it. TC-AP-07 (anti-pinch off when not normalized) and TC-AP-08 (repeated pinch lockout) should also be rerun, because the threshold and reversal changed.

LL-2022-02: cold and low voltage together is the worst case for stop time. TC-AP-04 covers it at 9.0 V and -30 °C, so keep it in every software release run. The 80 N threshold takes less force before detection but needs the 10 ms stop in the same corner.
Climatic operation (WLC-035) is linked to the pinch tests in the cold and hot corners. Rerun it after the 80 N and 150 mm changes.

WLC-012 now makes WLC_CloseAll an express close. Express close needs the controller to be normalized (WLC-013 and WLC-017). Add a case for WLC_CloseAll when not normalized and confirm the intended behaviour with the requirement owner.

The rain-sensor trigger was removed from WLC-012. Confirm that closing on rain is covered by a requirement elsewhere, for example in the body controller specification, and not dropped by mistake. Also check that the controller's WLC_CloseAll handling keeps anti-pinch active across the whole close.

With a 150 mm reversal, check that the rod position and window travel allow the full reversal, or the window reaches fully open first. Otherwise the pass limit cannot be checked. The reversal rule in WLC-015 says 'whichever is less'.

WLC-032 (sleep current below 100 µA) is deleted. Check that this is intentional. If the 100 µA limit is still a real need (battery drain), keep the check and make sure WLC-004 states it. Otherwise this test only checks whatever WLC-004 says.

Retiring the usability review removes the only check of switch feel and response. Confirm with the requirement owner that a product-level review exists elsewhere. A deleted vague requirement does not mean the review has no value.

LL-2024-01: a limit check that uses an estimate must make sure the estimate is current. WLC-025 now has hard limits (130 °C, 15 A). Check that the fix for the shared platform thermal module (WLC-200) is present. Rerun TC-TH-01, TC-TH-03 and TC-TH-04, because they depend on the same estimate and limit.

LL-2024-09: when the cycle time gets shorter (100 ms to 50 ms), repeat the worst-case queue calculation. Run under worst bus load, including diagnostic sessions. The fault state signal now also comes from WLC-038, so check it in the same frames.
Diagnostic response time (WLC-031) may depend on the old combined WLC-030 behaviour of stop motor and set fault state. Check its criteria against WLC-037 and WLC-038.
No change here, but LL-2023-05 asks for a sensor plausibility check with a timeout, and a sensor-removal test at the lowest supply voltage. Check that TC-DG-01 does this at the lowest supply voltage.
WLC-021 is editorial, so no test action is needed. Update the requirement text in the trace record only.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
